seriesTitle: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky

episodes.title: An Encounter
episodes.summary: At a party, reserved college student Kakeru meets a mysterious and charming young woman who is unable to see.

episodes.title: Fuyutsuki Koharu
episodes.summary: Kakeru takes Koyuki to try out an old piano and the two tour a Meiji era sailboat that is preserved on campus.

episodes.title: The Yellow Bookmark
episodes.summary: Kakeru and Koharu go to karaoke with friends and decide to check out the university's fireworks club together.

episodes.title: First Date
episodes.summary: Kakeru and Koharu go on their fireworks shopping trip and then enjoy a very relaxing ride home on a water bus.

episodes.title: Aerial Fireworks
episodes.summary: Kakeru and his roommate Narumi get a chance to take Koharu and Yuko for a ride on the college's cutter boat.

episodes.title: The Empty Terrace Seat
episodes.summary: Kakeru shares an intimate moment with Koharu and then turns to Narumi and Hayase for advice on how to proceed.

episodes.title: Transparent
episodes.summary: After Koharu disappears for a week, Kakeru and Yuko get a clue about where she is and run out to look for her.

episodes.title: Pangs of Love
episodes.summary: Hoping to spend time with Koharu, Kakeru and friends decide to volunteer at the hospital where she is staying.

episodes.title: Alone
episodes.summary: Still volunteering at the hospital, Kakeru learns more about Koharu's illness and happens to meet her mother.

episodes.title: Stay By Her Side
episodes.summary: With three months to go until the "Children's Fireworks" event that he and Hayase had planned, Sorano encouraged Fuyutsuki to do his best to fight his illness.He kept a watchful eye on Fuyutsuki's health, but her condition, which had been improving, suddenly worsened, making it impossible for him to visit her.While agonizing over the frustration and anxiety of being unable to do anything for her, he heard words that gave him the strength to move forward.
